{{Top}}
A '''baffle''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component designed to alter the direction of a [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive's]] exhaust. The resulting shift in direction subsequently altered the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] trajectory.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Baffles were also used in a starship's fresh [[Water/Legends|water]] tanks. A series of baffles reduced the motion of the water during space flight.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>
